title: NIIMBL annual program reporting: 2021-2022 report
publisher: National Institute for Innovation in Manufacturing Biopharmaceuticals
summary: The institute reported its member, project, and workforce portfolio for the 2021-2022 cycle. A direct stable report file was not identified during capture.
key_findings: The institute reported its member, project, and workforce portfolio for the 2021-2022 cycle.
Method: Institute annual reporting on projects, membership, workforce, and biomanufacturing activity.
Denominator: NIIMBL members, projects, and programs covered in each annual report.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the niimbl annual program reporting series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for manufacturing cohort and facility production.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: A direct stable report file was not identified during capture.
The observation is bounded to United States and the stated period.
The denominator is NIIMBL members, projects, and programs covered in each annual report.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
